segments.name: Protein Solutions
segments.description: Provides solutions for initial stage processing and harvesting of animal proteins, focusing on poultry, pork, fish, and beef.
segments.evidence: The Protein Solutions segment includes businesses that provide solutions for initial stage processing and harvesting of animal proteins, primarily focusing on poultry, pork, fish, and beef.

segments.name: Prepared Food and Beverage Solutions
segments.description: Offers solutions for downstream value-added preparation, preservation, and packaging of foods and beverages into ready to eat or drink products.
segments.evidence: The Prepared Food and Beverage Solutions segment includes businesses that offer solutions predominantly for downstream value-added preparation, preservation, and packaging of foods and beverages into ready to eat or drink products.

revenueModel.text: Food and beverage companies pay for customized processing systems and equipment, plus recurring aftermarket parts, service, re-build services, and operating leases on certain extractors.
revenueModel.evidence: Our historically strong position in the markets we serve has provided us with a large installed base of systems and equipment that is a source of recurring revenue from our aftermarket parts and service offerings and re-build services for customer-owned equipment.

changes.text: In 2025, JBT completed the acquisition of Marel hf. and changed its name to JBT Marel Corporation.
changes.evidence: On January 2, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Marel hf. ("Marel"), s ubsequently renamed JBT Marel ehf. (such acquisition, the "Marel Transaction").

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of 2025, the company realigned its reportable segments from JBT and Marel to Protein Solutions and Prepared Food and Beverage Solutions.
changes.evidence: During the fourth quarter of 2025, we realigned our reportable segments to better reflect the integration of our new operating model.

changes.text: In 2023, the company sold its AeroTech business segment to Oshkosh Corporation to become a pure-play food and beverage solutions provider.
changes.evidence: On August 1, 2023, we completed the sale of the AeroTech business segment ("AeroTech").
